title: Jellylike Velvety Greek Fish Galaktoboureko
description: A salty and velvety Greek dish featuring potato starch and fish, perfect for a post-workout meal. This pescatarian-friendly galaktoboureko is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Greek cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the potato starch and dum.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the cod fish to the bowl and stir gently to coat with the starch mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the fish mixture to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and season the fish with salt and pepper to taste.
